text:
lina: Quick flag: saw a p99 tail on /v1/generate around 08:02 UTC. p50 flat, p95 slight uptick, p99 ~+120ms. Could be routing/queueing or metric provenance.

mike: noted. We shifted some routing weights yesterday (EU->dedicated) but that shouldn't explain p99-only.

ashley: mobile home-feed canary sent more mobile-ios traffic; maybe gateway queues spiking for high-priority.

sangeet: do we currently tag sample_origin (gateway|proxy|backend) everywhere? I don't think so.

lina: console labels the chart "service_time" but doesn't say which emitter. That's ambiguous.

devx: UX quick-win: add a small legend pill showing "metric: gateway_total / backend_proc / combined" and a toggle "include queue time" default off. Hover text explains semantics.

paul: operationally we should add a runbook step: when route p99 exceeds baseline+threshold, inspect queue_time_histogram and sample_origin breakdown.

ops-bot: Autoscaler log: scaled +2 workers in eu-west-1 at 07:58 UTC.

mike: I pulled raw samples for 15m window. backend_proc_ms p99 = 310ms, gateway_total_ms p99 = 420ms, high-priority queue subset shows the larger gap.

sangeet: I'll add sample_origin and queue_time_ms to sample schema and open a PR today; will announce migration.

devx: once origin exists, console can surface a provenance pill and a "view raw samples" link to reproduce tails. Add unit tests for toggle behavior.

lina: Actions: 1) sangeet add telemetry fields (PR EOD). 2) mike update dashboard default to backend_proc_ms and add legend toggle. 3) devx mock UX and tests. 4) paul add runbook snippet. I'll follow up in this thread. :thumbsup:
